records.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?

response.answer:
To work with Getnet's receivables advance (antecipação), you need to meet the following conditions: [1] 

* You must have a Getnet account with a balance to draw on.
* You must have a Getnet-approved payment method (e.g., a card machine).
* You must be a merchant with a valid contract with Getnet.

To set up the receivables advance, you need to:

* Go to your Getnet account and navigate to the "Antecipação de Vendas" section.
* Follow the instructions to set up the receivables advance, which may include:
	+ Scheduling the advance (up to 3 days before the payment due date).
	+ Setting the advance amount.
	+ Authorizing the advance.
* The advance will be automatically applied to your account, and you will receive the funds on the next business day.

Note that the receivables advance is only available for merchants who have opted for the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" payment plan. [2] 

Additionally, you can also set up the receivables advance through the Getnet Internet Banking or by contacting the Getnet Central de Relacionamento. [3] 

It's also worth noting that the receivables advance is subject to certain conditions and may not be available for all merchants or in all situations.

records.message: Como funciona a antecipação de recebíveis na Getnet?

response.answer:
The Antecipação of Sales feature allows merchants to receive payments for their sales in advance, up to 2 days after the sale date. This feature is available for merchants who have a Getnet account and have opted for the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" payment plan. [1]

To be eligible for Antecipação of Sales, merchants must meet certain conditions, including having a minimum of 2 days' worth of sales in their account. [2] The feature is not available for all merchants, and the Getnet team reserves the right to evaluate each contract individually to determine eligibility. [2]

When a merchant opts for Antecipação of Sales, they will receive an email with the details of their contract, which will outline the terms and conditions of the feature. [4] The merchant must also meet certain requirements, such as maintaining a minimum faturamento and being adimplent. [4]

The Antecipação of Sales feature is available for a limited time, typically between 2 days before the sale date (D+1) and 3 days before the sale date (D-3). [1] During this time, merchants can choose to receive payments for their sales in advance, up to 2 days after the sale date. [1]

It's worth noting that the Antecipação of Sales feature is subject to certain tax rates, which vary depending on the payment method. [2] Merchants can use the Getnet website to simulate the tax rates for a given sale. [2]

If you have any further questions or would like more information on the Antecipação of Sales feature, I recommend contacting Getnet support.

records.message: What is the Getnet crediário?

response.answer:
The Getnet crediário is a type of in-store installment credit offered by Getnet to merchants. It is part of the merchant's contract of adhesion to the Getnet system and can be consulted on the Portal do Cliente and/or the Getnet Brasil app [1]. 

The crediário allows merchants to offer their customers installment payment options, with each card issuer setting its own limit on the number of installments. The interest rates for the customer are displayed through a simulation on the card machine, which can be viewed by inserting the card, including the value and payment option for credit > crediário [2]. 

To activate the crediário, merchants must contact the Getnet Central de Atendimento to request its activation. The crediário can be disabled by contacting the same central, and it is not available to all merchants [3].
